rationale: Stable v1.82.0 supports arrow-key movement only for Decor (#447); Plan walls/openings and Devices have no keyboard translation. This adds a new user capability for those editors: precise one-cell wall, opening and device movement with per-step Undo. Reusing existing physical and CAS writers does not make the new input behavior a fix to a capability already present in stable.

summary.ru: Сдвиг свободной стены, проёма и устройства стрелками на клетку с сохранением смещения и отдельной отменой каждого шага.
summary.en: Move free walls, openings and devices one grid cell with arrow keys, preserving their offset and individual Undo steps.
